label: Services we do
html:
SERVICES WE DO · 16 IN 4 GROUPS
Every service we do on American Standard furnaces
From a 2 a.m. no-heat call to a yearly clean, a parts claim or a new furnace. One company, one technician who knows the unit.

01
Repair & no-heat calls
Found and fixed on the first visit when the part is on the van.
No-heat emergency repair
A live dispatcher 24/7 and a technician the same day, any American Standard model.
Ignitor & flame sensor replacement
The most common American Standard fix. Genuine ignitors carried on every van.
Inducer motor & pressure switch repair
For the hum, rattle or shut-off before the burners light, plus the vent and hose behind it.
Control board, gas valve & blower motor
Tested on our meter first. Boards and motors cost real money, so we confirm before we replace.
02
Cleaning & tune-ups
Booked before the first cold snap, so it lights first time all winter.
Annual furnace tune-up
Burners, flame sensor, filter, gas pressure, vent and every safety switch, checked and logged.
Burner & flame sensor cleaning
Clears the soot that makes a furnace light, then shut off a few seconds later.
Blower wheel & motor cleaning
A packed wheel moves less air and overheats the unit. We pull it, clean it and balance it.
Condensate drain & PVC vent clearing
For 95% models: the trap, drain line and side-wall vents that freeze or block in a Chicago winter.
03
Safety & genuine parts
The checks and paperwork that keep your family and your warranty safe.
Heat exchanger & CO safety check
A camera inspection for cracks and a carbon monoxide test, with photos if we find anything.
Genuine parts & warranty claims
We check registration by serial and file the claim, so a covered part costs labor only.
AccuLink thermostat & controls
Set up, re-linked or replaced, so the furnace, thermostat and AC work as one system.
Gas pressure & combustion test
Measured on our meter, not by eye, so the furnace burns clean and at its rated output.
04
Replace & upgrade
When repair no longer adds up, or you want more from the system you have.
New American Standard furnace
Sized to your home, installed by our own crew, registered for the full parts warranty.
Repair-or-replace assessment
Both numbers on paper, the age of the unit and the parts outlook. You decide.
Humidifiers, filters & air cleaners
Added to your furnace for dry Chicago winters and cleaner air in every room.
Matching AC or heat pump
Paired with your American Standard furnace so the blower and controls match.
